messages:
Maya: FYI — we're seeing an activation backlog in the EU region starting ~08:10 UTC. Customers are getting stuck at 'processing assets' during tenant setup. Opening this thread to coordinate customer comms, mitigation, and renewal-risk triage. Details in INC-4321 (internal): https://redwood-internal/ops/INC-4321

Jordan: On it. Support queue shows ~48 activations queued; 12 are labeled high-touch (enterprise). Most report a hang  at the schema validation step.

Priya: Proposed immediate customer-facing items: 1) short status note with ETA, 2) invite to office hours for live troubleshooting, 3) one-time credit offer for impacted customers and a free enablement session. Draft below.

Sam: Short tech summary for context — we rolled a schema validation tightening earlier this morning. Under the higher parallel upload rate we hit a DB lock on the activations table, which slowed retries. Rolled a temporary patch to relax strictness at 08:45 UTC. That stopped new failures but the backlog is still draining.

Evie: Mitigations in flight: scaled activations workers + bumped concurrency for activation retries on EU clusters, enabled S3-based fallback ingest for uploads that timeout. CPU/IO stabilized post-scale, but backlog clearing ETA is ~6-8 hours depending on retry success rate. We will prioritize tenants with reserved/dedicated pools and those flagged for imminent renewals.

Maya: Customer comm plan (aiming to send first round by 09:15 UTC):
- Priority notice to affected accounts with clear ETA + link to status page
- Invite to two office hours slots for troubleshooting (EU-friendly times)
- Offer one-time credit and a 1:1 enablement session for high-touch accounts
- Collect simple feedback via short form to capture blocker details and renewal sentiment

Maya: Draft message (please copy/edit as needed):
```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We’re sorry — we’ve identified an issue affecting tenant activations in our EU region that may cause setups to stall at the "processing assets" step. Our engineers have deployed an initial mitigation and we expect most activations to complete within 6–8 hours.

What we’re doing now:
- Increasing processing capacity and enabling a temporary ingest fallback
- Prioritizing enterprise and soon-to-renew accounts for immediate attention
- Hosting two office hours (09:30 & 16:00 CET tomorrow) for live troubleshooting

How we’ll make this right:
- One-time account credit (applied to your next invoice)
- Complimentary 1:1 enablement session to finish the setup if needed

If you’d like direct help, reply to this message and we’ll prioritize you for a 1:1. Full status updates: https://status.redwood.ai/INC-4321

Thanks for your patience,
<Maya> on behalf of Customer Success
```

Jordan: LGTM. I'll send to the 12 enterprise contacts individually and do a bulk for the rest. Will include the status page link and an opt-in for office hours.

Priya: I’ll run the office hours (09:30 & 16:00 CET). I'll create a calendar invite and a Google Form to capture the minimal info we need (tenant id, step stuck, screenshots). Will post invite link in #customer-success.

Sam: Postmortem action items I'm owning: add regression test coverage around schema validation, a pre-deploy canary that runs a sample activation flow, and add telemetry to detect activation stalls earlier.

Maya: Action checklist:
- Evie: export impacted tenant list + priority flags (by 09:00 UTC)
- Jordan: send first wave of comms by 09:15 UTC and post status when done
- Priya: office hours invites + feedback form (post link here)
- Sam: initial RCA draft by EOD, include long-term mitigations
- Maya: coordinate credit approvals and renewal-risk notes for AE handoff

Evie: Impacted list exported (48 tenants). DMing a secure link to Maya and Jordan now. I’ve tagged tenants with commit size and renewal quarter.

incident-bot: Incident INC-4321 status update: mitigations deployed -> partial. Backlog draining; next automated update at 10:30 UTC.

Maya: Thanks. Jordan — can you confirm when the bulk send completes? Also surface any replies that indicate churn intent ("we may have to delay renewal") so we can escalate to AEs.

Jordan: 09:20 UTC — messages sent to 12 enterprise contacts and bulk send kicked off for midsize customers. Office hours calendar posted: https://cal.redwood.ai/INC-4321-office-hours :calendar: Will update with reply counts.

Priya: Office hours invite + feedback form posted in #customer-success: https://forms.redwood.ai/INC-4321-feedback. I'll monitor sign-ups and triage slots.

Maya: Perfect. If you get any "we're blocked" replies, ping me directly. We'll prioritize those for immediate 1:1s. Also please add any renewal risk flags to the shared tracker (link in the incident doc).

Jordan: Noted. So far three customers asked for immediate 1:1 help, flagged as high-priority. Bulk send showing ~85% delivered, ~5% bounced (invalid contact -> handing off to AE).

Evie: Backlog trending down; activations completing at ~9–11/min. If rate holds we'll be clear in ~5 hours. I'll update if anything regresses.

Maya: Great work team — keep replies short in the thread so CS can copy paste the latest to customers. I'll compile an exec brief after the RCA draft.

Sam: For the postmortem, proposed owners/timelines posted to INC-4321. Also recommending a permanent telemetry alert for "activation-hang > 5 min" and an automated retry escalation.

Maya: Thanks all. Closing coordination here for now — please continue to post status updates and any customer feedback.

Jordan: Will do. Posting a quick summary to affected accounts channel after I finish the bulk send. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Next update scheduled 10:30 UTC.
